The practical guidance given in *Mindfulness: The Path to the Deathless* instructs: *"Everything might as well be blown up, because if nobody is willing to use their life for anything more than just selfish indulgence, then it is worthless."*. When you sit on the cushion, do not wage war against wandering thoughts. It is like dropping a lump of salt into the vast River Ganges rather than a tiny cup: in the boundless ocean of awareness, past irritations dissolve completely. Rest the mind gently in the rhythm of each natural in-and-out breath.
